meta.name: airunway-aks-setup
meta.description: Set up AI Runway on AKS — from bare cluster to running model. Covers cluster verification, controller install, GPU assessment, provider setup, and first deployment. WHEN: "setup AI Runway", "onboard AKS cluster", "install AI Runway", "airunway setup", "deploy model to AKS", "GPU inference on AKS", "KAITO setup on AKS", "run LLM on AKS", "vLLM on AKS", "set up model serving on AKS", "AI Runway controller".

copy.tagline: 将AI Runway快速部署到Azure Kubernetes集群
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在Azure上搭建AI推理环境
copy.tagline_en: Deploy AI Runway onto an AKS cluster in minutes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set up AI inference on Azure

howto.what: 这个技能引导你在已有的 AKS 集群上从零开始部署 AI 模型。它依次检查集群状态、安装控制器、评估 GPU 兼容性、选择并安装推理服务（如 KAITO、Dynamo、KubeRay），最后部署第一个模型并验证运行就绪。每一步都会汇报状态，并在安装前征求你的确认。
howto.when: 当你说“setup AI Runway”“install AI Runway”等，或要求评估 GPU、部署模型到 AKS 时触发。需已有 AKS 集群，否则先转给 azure-kubernetes 技能。

say.text: 帮我在 AKS 集群上设置 AI Runway，再部署一个模型。
say.note: 会按顺序检查集群、安装控制器等并部署。

say.text: 检查我的 AKS 集群 GPU 能用哪些模型。
say.note: 会检测 GPU 型号并提示数据类型约束。

say.text: 用 KAITO 在 AKS 上部署一个 LLM。
say.note: 会安装推理服务 KAITO 并部署模型，验证就绪。

howto.what_en: Guides from a bare AKS cluster to a running model: verifies cluster, installs controller, assesses GPU, installs inference provider (KAITO/Dynamo/KubeRay), deploys first model, and verifies Ready. Reports status at each step and asks confirmation before installs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says phrases like "setup AI Runway" or "install AI Runway", or asks to assess GPU or deploy a model to AKS. Requires an existing AKS cluster; if not, it hands off to the azure-kubernetes skill first.

say_en.text: Help me set up AI Runway on my AKS cluster and deploy a model.
say_en.note: Runs through cluster verification, controller install, and deployment.

say_en.text: Check my AKS cluster's GPU compatibility for models.
say_en.note: Detects GPU models and flags constraints.

say_en.text: Use KAITO to run an LLM on AKS.
say_en.note: Installs the inference provider and deploys the model.
